name: merge-bar
description: The pull-request lifecycle against a merge bar fixed when the PR opens. Open a PR whose body carries seven fields (Claim, Scope, Known limits, Merge danger, Merge bar, Evidence, Closes); work it by sorting every reviewer finding as blocking or non-blocking against that bar, one push per round, with a stop at round 3 when the fixes are generating the findings, and non-blocking findings answered in the thread or recorded as known limits in the paired AI workspace's tech-debt ledger instead of filed as issues; review a PR as defect classes with every site, each sorted against that bar, in two parallel fresh-context axes (standards, and the Claim or spec), round 2+ on the fix diff only; teach a repository's reviewers the bar through an AGENTS.md Code Review Rules section and, on public repositories, a .coderabbit.yaml; and run a retro on the review record, proposing standards entries and deterministic checks for classes that repeat across PRs, written only when the operator accepts. Five prose skills, five slash commands, no lib, no state beyond one Markdown log.
